chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played Fathom the Tide on Nibbit, spending 6 Charge for 13 damage, then All Streams Flow to the Sea on Nibbit for 11 damage.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Coral Guard followed by Fathom the Tide, trading 11 damage for 5 Block against the telegraphed attack.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up Coral Guard's 5 Block, so I take the full telegraphed 12 damage in exchange for dealing 24 damage.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. A substantially larger telegraphed attack would have moved me to Coral Guard plus Fathom the Tide; a non-attack intent would not have changed this line.
